title: Kessler Owner Rewards Points Terms by Tier — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
**Owner Rewards points figures under Service Accounts and Repair Orders.**

| Tier | Points per whole dollar paid | Value of one redeemed point (USD) | Fewest points redeemed at one time | Largest share of a repair order's customer-pay labor and parts total points may pay | Most points one repair order can earn | Expiry period (months after the month earned) | Covered lines earn points | Enrollment bonus points |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Service Guest Account | 0 | 0.00 | 0 | 0% | 0 | 0 | No | 0 |
| Kessler Owner Rewards Silver | 1 | 0.01 | 500 | 50% | 5000 | 12 | No | 250 |
| Kessler Owner Rewards Gold | 2 | 0.01 | 500 | 50% | 10000 | 18 | No | 0 |
| Kessler Owner Rewards Platinum | 3 | 0.01 | 250 | 100% | 20000 | 24 | No | 0 |
| Commercial Fleet Account - Net 15 | 0 | 0.00 | 0 | 0% | 0 | 0 | No | 0 |
| Commercial Fleet Account - Net 30 | 0 | 0.00 | 0 | 0% | 0 | 0 | No | 0 |

A tier whose points per dollar reads 0 is not a points-earning tier. "Covered lines" are lines paid by a warranty, a recall, a service contract, a maintenance plan or goodwill.

**Hypothetical.** 1800 points redeemed at Kessler Owner Rewards Gold are worth 1800 times 0.01, that is 18.00.
